universe: all and only node_id values in the bound GraphFactManifest
selected_relation: all and only exact edge tuples whose predicate occurs in the bound property selected_predicates
required_sources: all and only source IDs in the bound property definition
target: the exact target ID in the bound property definition
join_requirement: both provider receipts and the join receipt bind the same exact scope contract, universe digest, selected-relation digest, and computed scope digest
